Windows normcase-only-for-cache-key pattern is repo-wide behavioral norm, not this bug
memory: os.path.normcase() lowercases paths on Windows but is a no-op on posix/macOS. In this repo, normcasing should only be used to build cache/dedup keys (e.g. via unique_path()), never applied to the actual path object handed to import machinery or written to __file__ — Windows verifies spelled module names against real directory entries, so a normcased path breaks imports. To test Windows-specific casing behavior on macOS, simulate with a sitecustomize.py setting os.path.normcase = str.lower.
